findings.evidence: Mathlib: `theorem Continuous.compMeasurePreservingLp (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) (hgm : ∀ z, MeasurePreserving (g z) μ ν) (hp : p ≠ ∞) : Continuous fun z ↦ Lp.compMeasurePreserving (g z) (hgm z) (f z)` (ContinuousCompMeasurePreserving.lean:100). Its section hypotheses `[BorelSpace X] [R1Space X] [μ.InnerRegularCompactLTTop] [IsLocallyFiniteMeasure ν]` are all available here: `R1Space G` via `IsTopologicalGroup.regularSpace` (Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/Pointwise.lean:312) and `Regular.lean:165`; `InnerRegularCompactLTTop (haarProb G)` via `instRegularOfIsHaarMeasureOfCompactSpace` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Haar/Unique.lean:689, needing only `[CompactSpace G]` on top of the ambient assumptions) and `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Regular.lean:1122`; `IsLocallyFiniteMeasure` from `isProbabilityMeasure_haarProb` (TauCeti/RepresentationTheory/Compact/Haar.lean:107). `p ≠ ∞` is an explicit argument, so no extra `Fact` instance is needed.
findings.fix: After `rw [continuous_clm_apply]; intro f; rw [Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.continuous_iff]`, close the goal with `continuous_const.compMeasurePreservingLp hg (fun g => measurePreserving_mul_right (haarProb G) g) (by simp)`, where `hg : Continuous fun g : G => (⟨(· * g), continuous_mul_right g⟩ : C(G, G))` is the same currying, at `X = G` (i.e. `(rightTranslate (ContinuousMap.id G)).continuous`). Then delete `rightRegularLp_eq_toLp_smul_rightTranslate` and the 𝕜-valued detour through `ContinuousMap.toLp` and the continuous representative; `rightTranslate` survives only in its `X = G` instance, if at all.
findings.issue: `continuous_convolutionEigenspaceRep`, together with the scaffolding it exists for (`rightTranslate` at line 103, `rightTranslate_apply_apply` at 108, `rightRegularLp_eq_toLp_smul_rightTranslate` at 202), re-derives strong continuity of right translation on L². Mathlib already proves it, in greater generality (any f, not just eigenvectors at μ ≠ 0): `Continuous.compMeasurePreservingLp` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/ContinuousCompMeasurePreserving.lean:100), also packaged as the instance `MeasureTheory.Lp.instContinuousSMulDomMulAct` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/DomAct/Continuous.lean:55).

findings.evidence: Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Function/LpSpace/DomAct/Basic.lean:36 `instance : SMul Mᵈᵐᵃ (Lp E p μ) where smul c f := Lp.compMeasurePreserving (mk.symm c • ·) (measurePreserving_smul _ _) f` and line 129 `instance : MulAction Mᵈᵐᵃ (Lp E p μ)`. Required instances hold for `M = Gᵐᵒᵖ`: `SMulInvariantMeasure Gᵐᵒᵖ G (haarProb G)` from `IsMulRightInvariant.toSMulInvariantMeasure_op` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Group/Defs.lean:104) with `isMulRightInvariant_haarProb` (Haar.lean:128), and `MeasurableConstSMul Gᵐᵒᵖ G` from `measurableSMul_opposite_of_mul` (Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Group/Arithmetic.lean:741).
findings.fix: Define `rightRegularLp`'s `toFun` as now and prove `map_one' = ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => one_smul _ x`, `map_mul' g h = ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => mul_smul (DomMulAct.mk (op g)) (DomMulAct.mk (op h)) x` (the two sides are defeq to the current ones; `MeasurePreserving` proofs are irrelevant), and delete `compMeasurePreserving_congr`.
findings.issue: The private `compMeasurePreserving_congr` and the hand-rolled `map_one'`/`map_mul'` of `rightRegularLp` (lines 143-152) re-derive the monoid action that Mathlib already defines: `DomMulAct.mk (MulOpposite.op g) • f` on `Lp E p μ` unfolds to `Lp.compMeasurePreserving (· * g) _ f` (since `op g • x = x * g`), and `MulAction (Gᵐᵒᵖ)ᵈᵐᵃ (Lp E p μ)` supplies `one_smul`/`mul_smul`.

summary: The mathematics of the eigenspace representation and its matrix-coefficient identification is new, but the continuity half re-derives Mathlib's strong continuity of Lp.compMeasurePreserving, and the monoid-hom laws of rightRegularLp re-derive Mathlib's DomMulAct action on Lp.
